title: Public Relations of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC):
text:
Public Relations of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC):"

"In the name of God, the Crusher of the tyrants,"
"And fight them until there is no persecution."

"🔹 Honorable and noble people of Iran, for one hundred and fifty consecutive nights, you have continued your gatherings across Islamic Iran without interruption, demanding vengeance for the blood of the martyred Imam and the expulsion of American aggressors from the region. Alongside you, your children in the Aerospace Force and the Ground Forces of the IRGC continue the battle against the aggressor enemy on the field with strength and courage."

"🔹 This morning, in continuation of Operation Nasr 2 and the punishment of the aggressor, they attacked the American airbase at Ali Al Salem, setting fire to and destroying two drone hangars and one fuel tank for airplanes and military helicopters."

"🔹 Let the Muslim people of Kuwait know that the punishment of the aggressor will continue until the plundering of the wealth and national resources of Muslims is brought to an end and the American occupiers and plunderers are expelled from the region."

"“And victory is not but from God, the Almighty, the Wise.”
